name: Maximalism
what_it_means: Maximalism rejects restraint. It layers bold patterns, clashing colours, multiple typefaces, stickers, collage and texture into rich, dense compositions. Done well, it feels curated chaos: joyful, energetic and impossible to ignore.
signature_moves: Many colours and several typefaces at once
Dense composition with a clear focal point
typefaces: energetic and impossible to ignore. **`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** → Layered patterns: stripes
checks → Many colours and several typefaces at once → Collage
rotated and outlined type → Dense composition with a clear focal point **`P A L E T T E`** `#FF3D7F #FFD400 #2B59FF #00B37E #FF7A00 T Y P E F A C E S` Abril Fatface
best_for: Fashion drops, festivals, music, creative agencies, youth brands
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [FESTIVAL / FASHION DROP] in a Maximalist style. Layer multiple bold patterns (checkerboard, polka dots, stripes) in clashing colours: hot pink #FF3D7F, yellow #FFD400, cobalt #2B59FF, green #00B37E, orange #FF7A00. Mix 3 typefaces (a fat serif like Abril Fatface, a display font like Monoton, a grotesk for body). Overlap rotated photo cut-outs, stickers, starbursts and a scrolling marquee. Keep one huge headline as the focal point so it reads despite the chaos. Add playful hover wiggles. Embrace density, but keep the CTA obvious.
